description: Bus and subway lines is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Data set containing geospatial information about the routes and stops of bus and metro lines from the Société de transport de Montréal. Important This data set is the property of the Société de transport de Montréal. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Bus stop, Bus, Bus, Subway, PolearTM. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
